author: SARA ESPAÑA
title: Clashes Erupt During Protest in Buenos Aires Against Economic Policies
text:
• Protest occurred on March 12, 2025, in front of Congress in Buenos Aires, Argentina.
• Demonstrators included retirees and soccer fans opposing President Javier Milei's economic policies.
• The protest escalated from peaceful to violent, with police using water cannons, tear gas, and pellets.
• Retirees have been protesting weekly for higher pensions due to a precarious standard of living.
• Previous protests had minor incidents, but this protest was unprecedented in scale.
• President Javier Milei's government has implemented public spending cuts since taking office 18 months ago.
• Police warned of restrictions on stadium entry for those causing disorder.
• Clashes began when Boca Juniors fans joined the protest, leading to police forming a cordon.
• Elderly protesters were pushed back by high-pressure water cannons.
• Fans from Boca Juniors, River Plate, and other clubs united with pensioners in the protest.
• Protesters chanted, 'Don’t touch the elderly,' and displayed signs advocating for their rights.
• Argentina's Ministry of Security issued a resolution banning violent individuals from entering soccer stadiums.
